title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a second shape to the Session 1 app: a glowing cylinder seen from the side
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app only shows a ball; a cylinder seen from the side has a different brightness profile (it is flat in the middle).

## Context
Comparing two shapes helps learners see that a pixel records a line integral, not the shape directly.

## Expected outcome
A shape selector in `sessions/session-01/app.html` (built from `content`) with a correct formula and a readout.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Profile matches a brute-force `ray_sum`
- [ ] Checkpoint extended and passing

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: choose the smoothing from the photo alone
body:
## Problem
The mini-project picks the smoothing strength by comparing with the known truth, which is impossible with a real photo.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, first milestone. Generalised cross-validation and the discrepancy principle are standard methods.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: find the flame axis
body:
## Problem
All sessions assume the flame axis is exactly at the image centre; a one-pixel error already hurts the result.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that estimates the axis position from a photo and shows the error with and without the correction.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Axis found to within 0.3 pixel on the candle photo
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a Fourier / cosine-series inversion and compare it with onion peeling
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses one smoothing method (second-difference Tikhonov). Fourier-series methods are a standard alternative.

## Context
The number of terms plays the role of the smoothing strength.

## Expected outcome
A function `fourier_invert(I, terms)` and a figure comparing bias and noise against the Session 3 method on the Gaussian and ring flames.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Validated on the exact Gaussian pair
- [ ] Short write-up of when each method is better

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Reproduce the Target: a 3D cut-away rebuilt from one noisy photo
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a clean 3D reconstruction from a noisy photo; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] RMS error at or below 0.025 of the peak on the 3 percent noise photo
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
